title: Manifest Repair
prompt:
Audit and repair the following fictional release manifest. The immutable intent fields must not be changed. All other listed fields are mutable. Report every violated rule ID and return the complete corrected manifest.

Immutable intent:
release_id=RX-73; environment=prod; version=3; phase=ready; risk=high.

Supplied mutable fields:
artifact_verified=false; tests_passed=false; reviewer_present=true; rollback_ready=false; change_ticket=true; window=closed; schema=1.

Rules:
R1: if phase=ready, tests_passed=true.
R2: if phase=ready, artifact_verified=true.
R3: if phase=ready, reviewer_present=true.
R4: if environment=prod, phase=ready.
R5: if environment=prod, rollback_ready=true.
R6: if environment=prod, change_ticket=true.
R7: if environment=prod, window=open.
R8: if risk=high, reviewer_present=true and rollback_ready=true.
R9: if version=3, schema=2.

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"violations":["R1","R2"],"manifest":{"release_id":"RX-73","environment":"prod", ...}}}
The repair must use the minimum number of mutable-field edits.
